resources.string: Getting Idena Social ready
This app reads Idena Social from the network itself, through a small node that runs on this phone: no company server in between. The first start takes a while.
Your account
Connecting to other nodes
Downloading the network
Catching up with the latest blocks
Your phone does not download every block since the start: it downloads the block headers, then the network\'s latest state (a snapshot) from another node.
Create your account, or import the one you have, in the node panel. Save its key right away: it is the only way back into this account.
Sync is off: the node does not run, so nothing is read. Turn Sync on in the node panel.
Open the node panel
Sync is off
The node could not start: %1$s
Up to date. Your feed fills in as the network is read: the newest posts first.
It can take several minutes, up to about 15, before a first node accepts yours. Keep the app open meanwhile.
On mobile data or a hotspot, other nodes often cannot reach your phone, and it finds peers slowly. Wi-Fi helps.
Your node waits for another node to send it the network\'s latest state. It goes on by itself once a peer offers it.
It has waited %1$d minutes: your peers do not offer the state yet. It still goes on by itself; more peers help (Wi-Fi, keeping the app open).
The node stops while the phone sleeps or when Android stops the app: it catches up with the blocks made meanwhile when it runs again.
Keep the app open during the first sync: Android may stop the node with the screen off. These settings let it run in the background.

For priority access, add nodes you trust in Direct peers (Advanced settings, in the node panel), and exchange your peer codes: your own node running at home all day (the Idena desktop app, its router port open), or a validator of the network you trust.
Good to know
A good habit: sync at home on Wi-Fi. Outside, the node then only catches up with the last blocks, quickly: write on Idena Social, then turn Sync off until you need it.
Idena is a decentralized network: the more people run it, the faster everyone finds peers to sync with. Tell your friends about it.
You can earn iDNA for free by becoming a validator of the network. The more validators, the faster peers and posts travel, and the lower the fees: the network\'s minimum fee goes down as it grows.
Reading older posts: %1$d%%. They are read only while Idena Social is on screen: keep it open to read them all.
Posting needs a little iDNA
Each post, reply, like or tip is a transaction on the network, paid with a small fee in iDNA from your account: it keeps spam off the network. Your balance is 0 iDNA. Reading Idena Social stays free.
How to get iDNA
Someone sends you some, or tips one of your posts: share your address with them.
Ask in the Idena community chats:
Or earn iDNA for free by becoming a validator of the network.

The more validators, the better for everyone: more nodes to connect to, so syncing and posts go faster, and lower fees, since the network\'s minimum fee goes down as the number of its validated identities goes up.
